messages:
alex: Created RC 3.1.1-rc1. Artifact rwinference/serve:20260401-rc1. Requesting pin + promo during the quiet window starting in 20m.

deploy-bot: CI smoke checks passed (3/3). Artifact pinned: deploy.pin(rwinference/serve,20260401-rc1). Staging and prod-candidate pools updated.

tia: Note: this includes a KV eviction tweak for embed-service. Recommend a KV warm step pre-promo to avoid p95 spikes.

ops-ryan: Agreed. I'll schedule /ops/kv-warm --service embed-service --shards 0-3 --duration 12m, to start ~T-12m. Oncall: @sam will watch.

sam: Oncall ack. Rollout plan: canary 2% (8m) -> 30% (15m) -> gradual to 100%. Telemetry gates only. Abort if error_rate >= 0.6% OR p95 >= 1.4x baseline. Also monitor gen_quality evals for regressions.

tia: Release notes draft: "KV eviction improvement; kernel-selection logging tightened; minor batching heuristics tuned." I'll push to release-notes/3.1.1-rc1.md.

deploy-bot: Pre-promo checklist: pinned artifact, smoke green, KV warm hook ready, canary policy configured. Promote command: /deploy promote --pin 20260401-rc1 --rollout canary:2,30,100

ops-ryan: KV warm started at 1776033420. Running warmers against shards 0-3.

deploy-bot: Promo window opens at 1776033480. Promotion will post step updates.

alex: If no objections by T-2m we proceed. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve.

tia: :thumbsup:

ops-ryan: :thumbsup: monitoring ready

sam: :white_check_mark: approved and watching the dash.

deploy-bot: Promotion started: 2% canary at 1776033560. Metrics streaming to /dash/rc1-canary.

sam: Monitoring first 8m now. Will call ramp at +8m if gates pass.

deploy-bot: Canary passed initial gate. Ramping to 30% at 1776033645.

ops-ryan: Saw a small token-cost bump (+4%) at canary start, within expected noise. No abort.

sam: Reminder: rollback command (keeps stable artifact pinned) --

/deploy rollback --service rwinference/serve --to 20260329-stable

ops-ryan: Keeping 20260329-stable pinned in staging for fast rollforward.

deploy-bot: Final gradual lift started. Full promotion complete at 1776033700. Release notes published; closing thread. :shipit:
